GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, kept on ok after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. shared lead turn under pressure. dropped right out # poor
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, only Held Ground in Straight # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Contacted at the start by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Worked fwd keenly 3 Wide until raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) @ 1200m. Tracked leaders Two Wide until pushed out 3 Wide @ 600m & Four Wide @ 550m. Pushed along Six Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 300m & hampered @ 200m. Gave ground in last 150m. Vetted - 2/5 near hind # Pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Passing the 900m when racing keenly, had to be restrained after improving into an awkward position to the inside of heels. Approaching the 200m laid in under pressure before being shifted out and then had to be steadied from heels. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the near hind leg and had sustained superficial abrasions to the near hindquarter. Trainer was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. looking for run turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 5 Lengths into Clear Turning for home Hard Ridden couldn't quicken run ended 300 - # Just Battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Brushed the running rail near the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled from Outside Settled Down 7th 3 Wide with a trail 4 Lengths Out On A Limb x 800m, Four Wide x 400m, kept on okay to 200m Couldn'T Go On - # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover from the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. under pressure turn. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider said his mount was under pressure from the 500m and did not respond to his riding in the straight and was disappointing. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 4 Wide early then eased to get cover 1200 metres. hooked 4 Wide turn. ran on well looked beaten in Straight but found plenty # strong win

Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, put pressure on leader at the 600m and took over before the corner, wanted to lay in a touch at 200m and was headed, weakened from then on # weakened 200m
Bit Slow Out 1 length settled near last 10l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, made some ground but never threatening # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported he had been instructed to obtain a prominent position in the first three if possible, however after his mnt reared at the start and lost ground it settled further back, and when placed under pressure in the straight it was one-paced to the finish. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr subsequently reported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the gelding and believes it was not suited by the way it was ridden.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on strong no match winner late (stewards vision only) # had chance
